scope: Published NEMA14/RP2040 with 14HM11-0404S motor; final review supplements geometric DRC with manufacturer layout, physical retention and assembly/process review.

findings.title: Tighten RP2040 regulator bypass connections
findings.evidence: C_VREG_OUT pad-centre distance 3.560 mm; found trace chain about 12.20 mm with BOTTOM detour.
findings.acceptance: Place the specified 1 uF input/output bypass close to VREG_IN/VREG_OUT, connect directly with low-inductance ground returns, and rerun layout/CAM checks.

findings.title: Compact the AP63203 input/switching/feedback layout
findings.evidence: VIN-to-C_BUCK_IN positive pad-centre distance 7.405 mm; feedback pad is 11.436 mm from C_BUCK_OUT1 positive pad.
findings.acceptance: Place VIN bypass directly across IC supply/ground, compact the bootstrap/inductor/output loop and review the feedback pickup against the manufacturer layout.

findings.title: Shorten A4988 sense and local supply paths
findings.evidence: SENSE1/2 to shunts found trace chains about 8.48/9.67 mm; VBB1-to-C_VM about 17.79 mm trace chain.
findings.acceptance: Place shunts adjacent to SENSE pins with low-impedance driver-ground returns; place local ceramic/bulk bypass at the supply pins.

findings.title: Proposed screws do not reach the motor
findings.evidence: 6 mm shaft is 1.6 mm shorter than PCB plus spacer, before engagement. Rear threads/retention remain unverified.
findings.acceptance: Obtain rear retention geometry and specify real fasteners/spacers with adequate engagement, no bottoming and measured tolerances.

findings.title: RGB depends on programming-USB power
findings.evidence: D_STATUS common anode is DATA_VBUS, not a supply available during normal PD-only operation.
findings.acceptance: Confirm USB-only RGB is intentional, or revise the LED supply/drive circuit for standalone status.

findings.title: MCU phase-current telemetry is absent
findings.evidence: Each SENSEx net connects only A4988 and its shunt; MCU ADCs read motor voltage and programming USB voltage.
findings.acceptance: Confirm driver-only sensing is sufficient, or add a properly conditioned MCU current-measurement interface before freezing the board.

findings.title: Approve the actual PCBA process and quote
findings.evidence: Three filled/capped exposed-pad vias; eight 0.7 mm USB shell stakes with no stencil paste on a 1.6 mm board; stock and pickup approval pending.
findings.acceptance: JLCPCB confirms via fill/cap, shell-joint soldering, polarized-part orientation, actual BOM stock, stackup/copper and any panelization requirements.

post_prototype_tests: USB boot/flash and both cable orientations
3.3 V/1.1 V startup, ripple and transients
Both phase currents, regeneration and thermal behavior
